主要内容: Nicholas Financial, Inc. (NASDAQ: NICK) announced on February 4, 2015, that it executed an amendment to its existing credit facility. The amendment increases the credit line from $150 million to $225 million, contingent on the successful completion of a tender offer for up to $70 million in common shares. The tender offer is expected to commence on or about February 12, 2015. If the tender offer is not completed, the credit line will remain at $150 million. The amended credit facility has a termination date of January 31, 2018. Additionally, the company reported a 2% decrease in net earnings for the three months ended December 31, 2014, to $3,769,000, compared to $3,827,000 for the same period in 2013. Revenue increased by 5% to $21,800,000 for the quarter ended December 31, 2014, compared to $20,761,000 for the same period in 2013.
